basic.label: Cow
basic.note: A baby cow is called a calf.

basic.label: Pig
basic.note: A baby pig is called a piglet.

basic.label: Sheep
basic.note: A baby sheep is called a lamb.

basic.label: Horse
basic.note: A baby horse is called a foal.

basic.label: Hen
basic.note: A hen lays eggs that can hatch into chicks.

basic.label: Duck
basic.note: A baby duck is called a duckling.

advanced.label: Calf
advanced.note: A calf drinks milk from its mother cow.

advanced.label: Piglet
advanced.note: A piglet drinks milk from its mother pig.

advanced.label: Lamb
advanced.note: A lamb drinks milk from its mother sheep.

advanced.label: Foal
advanced.note: A foal stands on long legs soon after birth.

advanced.label: Chick
advanced.note: A chick pecks at food with its small beak.

advanced.label: Duckling
advanced.note: A duckling has soft down before its feathers grow.

advanced.label: Kid
advanced.note: A baby goat is called a kid.

advanced.label: Gosling
advanced.note: A baby goose is called a gosling.
